semantics.row_granularity: one canonical exchange calendar-date record; closed dates are explicit rows, so this is not an open-session-only list
semantics.session: calendar date in the named Chinese exchange's local Asia/Shanghai calendar; it carries no intraday trading-hours schedule

is_open.true: the exchange calendar declares an open trading session on this date
is_open.false: the exchange calendar declares this date closed
is_open.missing_row: unknown; absence must not be interpreted as closed

previous_open_session.definition: for the same exchange, the greatest session strictly earlier than this row whose is_open value is true
previous_open_session.left_boundary: null is allowed only when the artifact coverage cannot prove a predecessor before its left boundary

validation: rows are emitted in declared sort order
exchange is one of SSE or SZSE
closed calendar dates are represented by rows with is_open=false
after the left boundary, previous_open_session equals the nearest strictly earlier open session for the same exchange
